title: Artworks reported removed from Kherson Regional Art Museum during occupation
summary: Ukrainian officials reported that a large part of the collection was taken away while the city was occupied.

title: Skovoroda literary museum in Kharkiv region destroyed by a missile strike
institution: Hryhorii Skovoroda National Literary and Memorial Museum
summary: A strike during the Russian invasion wrecked the museum building dedicated to the philosopher and poet.

title: Fire engulfs the National Museum of Brazil in Rio de Janeiro
summary: A fire swept through the historic palace that housed the museum, destroying most of its collections.

title: Mosul Central Library books burned by armed extremists
summary: Fighters who controlled the city burned large parts of the library's collection.

title: Manuscript institute in Timbuktu set on fire as armed groups withdrew
summary: Retreating fighters burned part of a manuscript centre, though much of the collection had been smuggled out earlier.

title: Institut d'Égypte in Cairo burned during street clashes
summary: A fire during clashes near Tahrir Square destroyed much of the scholarly society's library and rare holdings.

title: Historical Archive of the City of Cologne collapses during subway construction
institution: Historical Archive of the City of Cologne
summary: The archive building fell into a construction pit, burying one of Europe's largest municipal archives; recovery and restoration took years.

title: Iraq's National Library and Archive burned and looted in 2003
summary: The building was set on fire and looted in the chaos after the invasion, with heavy losses to book and archive holdings.

title: Iraq Museum in Baghdad looted after the fall of the city
summary: Thousands of objects were taken in the days after the city fell; a large share has since been recovered.

title: National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina burned in the siege of Sarajevo
institution: National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina (Vijećnica)
summary: Shelling set the City Hall building on fire, and most of the library's collections were lost in the blaze.

title: Jaffna Public Library burned during communal violence
summary: A mob set the library on fire, destroying tens of thousands of volumes including rare manuscripts.

title: Arno flood submerges Florence's national library and other collections
summary: Floodwater and mud damaged an enormous number of books, manuscripts and artworks, prompting a landmark international conservation effort.
